question: Does increasing Transformer depth from 4 to 8 or 12 reduce validation MAE under the existing training recipe?
reference: shared-token-transformer-v1, completed depth4, runtime commit e1c5375359b0faf05e240f95fa175d8604df6d4e
prediction_token: one shared trainable 128-vector, expanded six times plus temporal PE
input_and_readout: Linear(4,128); shared Linear(128,1) on future states
precision: BF16 autocast; FP32 parameters and AdamW states
optimizer: AdamW, weight_decay0.01, clip norm1, 50-update warmup to0.0003, cosine decay to0.00003
execution: Reuse completed depth4; train depth8 and depth12 sequentially. Confirm exact fixed batch with ten complete updates; fail instead of silently changing batch.
selection: Minimum mean six-horizon validation MAE among update0 and every25 updates through1000
report: Best and final validation MAE; six horizon MAEs; full train/validation curves; paired date-block gains for 8vs4,12vs4,12vs8; parameter counts and runtime
limitations: One fit per depth under one fixed optimization recipe. Validation used for checkpoint and depth selection; conditional intervals do not adjust selection. Equal update/sample budget does not mean equal compute.
